title: HostCover Plan Benefit: Payout Methods Transfer Fee Discount
content:
Hosts who protect their listings with Host Damage Protection (HostCover) receive a discount on the transfer fees charged on their Payout Methods. The transfer fee's HostCover discount is 11 percent when the host's active HostCover plan is at HostCover Premier, HostCover Elite or HostCover Estate, 5 percent at HostCover Standard or HostCover Plus, and nothing at HostCover Essential or with no active plan.

## Benefit by HostCover level

| Level of the host's active HostCover plan | HostCover discount on the transfer fee |
|---|---|
| HostCover Estate | 11 percent |
| HostCover Elite | 11 percent |
| HostCover Premier | 11 percent |
| HostCover Plus | 5 percent |
| HostCover Standard | 5 percent |
| HostCover Essential | Nothing |
| No active HostCover plan | Nothing |

The level is read from the host's HostCover plan whose status is active. A plan pending activation, cancelled or lapsed is not an active plan.

## Hypothetical illustrations

- An imagined host with an active HostCover Plus plan: the transfer fee's HostCover discount is 5 percent.
- An imagined host whose only HostCover plan, at HostCover Elite, lapsed last month: there is no active plan, so there is no HostCover discount.
- An imagined host with an active HostCover Essential plan: nothing.
